# Write a new adapter

The guide with the sample fields and everything the conformance suite checks is `harness/core/contracts/new-adapter.md`; the roles of each axis are in the contract of the axis next to it (`stack.md`, `runtime.md`, `host.md`). In short:

1. Choose where the adapter lives, and ask the owner when it is not clear: **into the framework** (a checkout of the framework; it reaches every project with a release) or **local** (the project's own repository, when it cannot wait for a release). Copy `harness/adapters/<axis>/_skeleton/` to `adapters/<axis>/<name>/` of the checkout, or to `harness-adapters/<axis>/<name>/` of the project, and set `name` in its manifest to the folder's name. A local adapter imports nothing from the framework's tools by a relative path.
2. Fill the manifest role by role from the contract of the axis; write the logic modules as pure functions with `node --test` tests next to them; fill `conformance.json`, and for a runtime record the event samples.
3. Run `node harness/tools/harness.mjs adapter test <the folder>` until every check passes; a check that fails names what is missing.
4. If a tool of the stack does not fit a role as the contract words it (it writes no neutral coverage summary, keeps its version outside JSON, excludes paths with a setting), read "What a stack learns the hard way" in the guide before you work around it, and fix the guide when your case is not there.
5. Into the framework: record the adapter in `framework.json`, the changelog and the framework README, add it to the framework's conformance tests, and offer it upstream. Local: name it `local:<name>` in `adapters.stacks`, `adapters.runtimes` or `adapters.host` of the profile file (the bootstrap selects presets, so bootstrap with the nearest one first), run `harness sync --local` and `harness check all`; a sync and a migration leave the folder alone, and `harness check all` and `harness migrate` run the suite on it. To send it upstream later, copy the folder into a checkout of the framework as in the first case, offer it, and when a release holds it, switch the profile file to the plain name and delete the local folder.
